summary_en: Katitas launched a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Tobu Juhan (code 3297), listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and Fukuoka Exchange Q-Board, at JPY 2,000 per share for 35 business days from October 14 to December 3, 2026. The minimum tender requirement is 1,776,600 shares (65.64% of voting rights), with no upper limit, to achieve complete subsidiary status.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of Tobu Juhan Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 3297)
translation_en_brief:
Katitas Co., Ltd. (Ticker: 8919, listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market) announced on October 13, 2026, that its board of directors has decided to launch a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Tobu Juhan Co., Ltd. (Ticker: 3297, listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and Fukuoka Exchange Q-Board). The offer price is JPY 2,000 per share, with a tender period of 35 business days from October 14, 2026, to December 3, 2026.

The minimum tender requirement is set at 1,776,600 shares, which would result in Katitas holding 65.64% of voting rights following acquisition. No upper limit has been set, as Katitas intends to acquire all of Tobu Juhan's outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares) to make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. As of October 13, 2026, Katitas does not hold any shares of Tobu Juhan.

The target company's management supports the tender offer. Tobu Juhan's representative director and largest shareholder Toshihiro Ogino, who owns 1,047,700 shares (38.66% ownership stake), along with OTC Co., Ltd. (a management company he controls, holding 138,400 shares or 5.11%), and Shitomi Ogino (his spouse, holding 33,600 shares or 1.24%), have agreed to tender all their shares, totaling 1,219,700 shares or 45.01% of outstanding shares, through share subscription agreements with Katitas.
